trimmed_dict.title: Looking Back to the United States 1976 Bicentennial
trimmed_dict.description: "Looking Back to The United States 1976 Bicentennial" exhibition is now on display at Alden Library by the fourth-floor stairwell. As we prepare to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the United States this year, we look back to the Bicentennial celebrations 50 years ago. The exhibition features archival materials and includes items from notable Ohioans, poet James Kilgore and composer Eusebia Hunkins, both of whom contributed to the Bicentennial through the arts. There are also original receipts from the Revolutionary War that are part of the W.E. Peters collection. The exhibition will be on display through the spring semester.
